 When We Were Young Festival announces 2027 return, Blink-182 and Pierce the Veil set to headline 
 Nov 17 
 News 
 Kayla Moreno 
 Las Vegas' emo takeover, When We Were Young Festival , returns in 2027 with a massive lineup. 
 After a brief pause, the fest is making a huge comeback, including headlining performances by Blink-182 and Pierce the Veil, at the Las Vegas Fairgrounds on Saturday, October 16.
 Rumors have swirled over the past month that the festival has plans for next year. However, these were largely silenced due to the recent Vans Warped Tour Dates. The sister festivals have massive overlap, allowing When We Were Young to keep their lineups relatively secured while Warped closed out their summer touring schedule.
 Ashlee Simpson and Natasha Bedingfield join 2027's festival lineup, adding a bit of versatility to what was otherwise a relatively fixed niche event. The Academy Is... and Saves The Day are also among the eclectic alternative mix. It's all about balance!
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by When We Were Young Festival (@whenwewereyoungfest) 
 As of now, When We Were Young only lists October 16 for performances. However, historically, the festival tends to add a second date after ticket sales exceed expectations. The first festival date almost always sells out within days of its announcement. 
 Hopefully, 2027's event doesn't leave thousands of emos wandering the strip aimlessly due to intense winds. In 2022, the first festival day was canceled due to dangerous wind, with up to 60 mph gusts. This year's lineup is stacked!
